[[File:Kevin Shannon 2011 MPC.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Kevin Shannon at the 2011 Match Play Championship.]]
'''Kevin Shannon''' (GEMP handle '''Kevbozzz''')<ref name="cc1" /> finished 4th at the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] Day 3. His Game 2 modified win vs Steve Brentson is the cut-math example on [[Tournaments]].
